channel.title: KALIST — Calisthenics guides and blog
channel.description: Calisthenics app: bodyweight programs, a skill journey and an on-device camera coach.

item.title: How to do your first pull-up: a 5-step progression
item.description: Get your first pull-up in 5 steps: dead hang, active hang, Australian rows, negatives and the strict pull-up. Goals, training frequency and common mistakes.

item.title: Muscle-up progression: prerequisites and the 6 steps to your first rep
item.description: A step-by-step muscle-up progression on the bar: pull-up and dip prerequisites, explosive pull-ups, straight bar dips and the transition, in 6 steps.

item.title: Front lever progression: from hollow body to full front lever
item.description: Front lever progression in 6 steps: hollow body, pull-ups, tuck front lever, advanced tuck, one-leg and full front lever. Hold times and training tips.

item.title: Planche progression: from tuck planche to full planche
item.description: Learn the calisthenics planche: wrist preparation, planche lean, tuck planche, advanced tuck, straddle and full planche. Training tips and common mistakes.

item.title: Handstand progression: how to learn to balance on your hands
item.description: Learn the handstand step by step: wrist prep, frog stand, pike push-ups, back-to-wall and chest-to-wall handstands, then freestanding. Safe bail-out included.

item.title: L-sit progression for beginners: from plank to V-sit
item.description: Learn the L-sit: plank, compression, tuck L-sit, one-leg L-sit, full L-sit and V-sit. Hold targets, equipment and the mistakes to avoid.

item.title: Pistol squat progression: how to master the one-leg squat
item.description: Master the pistol squat (one-leg squat): bodyweight squat, reverse lunge, split squat, cossack squat, assisted pistol and full pistol. Mobility and tips.

item.title: Beginner calisthenics program: a 3-day plan to get started
item.description: A beginner calisthenics program with two workouts, A and B, alternated three times a week: exercises, sets, reps, rest times and how to progress.

item.title: Calisthenics at home with no equipment: 12 exercises to start
item.description: 12 calisthenics exercises you can do at home with no equipment, for upper body, legs and core, plus a 20-minute beginner circuit.

item.title: Street workout vs calisthenics: what’s the difference?
item.description: Street workout and calisthenics both mean bodyweight training. Their origins, differences, disciplines and how to get started with either.
